indicator_name: Real GDP growth of world economies, percent (World Bank WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG)
description: Рост реального ВВП стран мира, % (Всемирный банк, WDI)
methodology: Item = ISO3; 1961 onward. For the CIS 1991-2000 equal to the CIS Stat official volume indices except Turkmenistan (1993: WDI +1.5, CIS Stat -10.0; 1995-99 differ) and Tajikistan 1992 (-29.0 vs -29.6). Kazakhstan 1991 -11.0, 1992 -5.3 = BNS table 4440. WDI last updated 2026-07-13.
